comment:
DPI-H components (right set): Yes, broadly. 
The proposed DPI-H components reflect the core capabilities needed to address the fragmentation that characterizes many health information systems, including those in the Philippines. Shared registries, longitudinal records, interoperability services, and governance mechanisms are appropriate priorities because they enable data reuse, continuity of care, and more efficient investments. However, successful implementation also requires strong institutional capacity and sustainable financing, which should be emphasized alongside the technical components.
